text:
Alex H: spotted weird invoice-preview surge for tenant `bar-llc` at 09:02 UTC. preview shows +42% tokens, final ledger stable.
Priya R: ugh. any recent router/egress changes?
Alex H: Edge team rotated a host pool at 09:00 for a capacity bump. suspect NAT churn.
Jonas T: That fits. Our fingerprint uses connection_id in session_hash; connection_id is created per TCP connection -> changes on NAT.
Alex H: Right, preview pipeline dedupes by fingerprint earlier than final ledger, so mismatches when fingerprint flips mid-flight.
Priya R: Can we replay dedupe later in the pipeline on req_id? That would catch duplicate token events even if fingerprint changed.
Jonas T: We do have req_id dedupe, but some clients (older SDKs) don't surface X-Request-Id reliably. Also proxy injects x-generated-client for keepalive flows.
Alex H: Example header observed in logs:

Jonas T: ```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer key_abc
X-Request-Id: none
X-Generated-Client: conn-77b4
```

billing-bot: metric: billing.preview_delta_pct{tenant="bar-llc"} = 42.1
Priya R: Short-term mitigation: pin egress for the pool that rotated, or rollback that host rotation. Can we do a quick pin?
Jonas T: Ops prefers rollout, but I'll ask them to pin the affected AZ for 20m.
Alex H: Mid-term fix proposals: (1) prefer X-Request-Id when present for top-level dedupe; (2) compute a stable payload_hash fallback (hash of model+input tokens+api_key) for dedupe; (3) instrument a telemetry counter for events that used generated-client.
Priya R: +1 on payload_hash. we need to be careful about perf - hashing at very high QPS could cost. maybe only compute for events where req_id missing or client-id generated.
Jonas T: Agree. We'll gate payload_hash behind a boolean and only enable for affected tenants during canary.
Alex H: Also need UI/console UX change: show a short reason next to "Invoice preview differs from final" with link to runbook and whether a rollback/pin is in progress. Support keeps opening tickets.
Priya R: I'll draft the console blurb. keep it short: "Preview may differ due to transient edge routing changes. See runbook." with a link.
billing-bot: alert: invoice-preview delta > 30% for tenant bar-llc. auto-ack=false
Jonas T: Plan for deploy: add dedupe-v2 that prefers req_id then payload_hash (feature-flagged). Canary in staging -> shadow in prod for 1h -> enable for 5% tenants. DevOps will coordinate.
edge-bot: note: egress pool pin requested for pool-us-west-2a by @Jonas T. ETA 10m
Alex H: I'll open INC-4099 and attach sample query and diffs. Also create a dashboard card: billing.preview_vs_final with a drilldown for tenant.
Priya R: Add an alert that triggers when preview_vs_final > 20% for > 5min and annotate with last egress change.
Jonas T: I'll push a small CFN change to expose the generated-client header count telemetry. will send PR after lunch.
Alex H: TL;DR: pin egress short-term, deploy dedupe-v2 behind flag, telemetry + console annotation, retro after incident.
Priya R: Assigning follow-ups: INC-4099 (investigate & customer outreach), PR-5421 (dedupe-v2), DASH-78 (console blurb & alert).
billing-bot: log: INC-4099 created by Alex H - https://redwood.internal/inc/4099
Alex H: thanks all. We should also add a note to rollout checklist: "avoid simultaneous egress host rotation during high-traffic resizes" :memo:
